calculation.description: Ranks 20-day momentum normalized by 40-day realized volatility. In a broad positive cross-asset tape (at least half of instruments positive over 20 days), preserves trend direction; otherwise flips the signal to favor cross-sectional reversal. The breadth state and all inputs are lagged/causal at the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC remained positive in all reported regimes: 2025-2027 +0.082636 (371 dates), 2028-2029 +0.028436 (521 dates), 2030-2032 +0.051743 (784 dates), 2033-2034 +0.016028 (293 dates). The available online data window begins 2026-07-27; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the cross-section is 15 assets.
